project.title: HeyPCB LED Art 2
project.summary: More shaped LED boards inspired by films: a light bulb for Edison's thousand failures, a starfighter, a submarine, a snowman, an atom, a trophy for the underdog, each in its own colour. KiCad 10, JLCPCB-ready, CERN-OHL-S-2.0.

boards.title: HeyPCB Atomic
boards.summary: Three electron orbits from a 1950s science-fiction title card, lit in a blue mask.

boards.title: HeyPCB Gravity
boards.summary: An apple, for the one that fell on the right head and turned into a theory of gravity.

boards.title: HeyPCB Bones
boards.summary: A bone-white skull from a pirate film's cursed treasure.

boards.title: HeyPCB Eureka
boards.summary: A light bulb, for the inventor who said he hadn't failed, he'd found a thousand ways that didn't work. The LEDs run round the glass.

boards.title: HeyPCB Champion
boards.summary: A trophy cup from the sports film where the underdog loses every game in the first act.

boards.title: HeyPCB Clock
boards.summary: A twelve-sided clock face for the time-travel film where the inventor's machine fails until the lightning strikes.

boards.title: HeyPCB Clockwork
boards.summary: A big-toothed gear from a steampunk inventor's workshop, where half the machines explode.

boards.title: HeyPCB Compass
boards.summary: An eight-point compass rose from a pirate treasure map. The first two maps were always fakes.

boards.title: HeyPCB Dial
boards.summary: A ten-sided radio dial from a film about a signal from somewhere else.

boards.title: HeyPCB High Noon
boards.role: High Noon LED art, green mask
boards.summary: A saguaro cactus that stands in every spaghetti-western standoff, waiting for high noon.

boards.title: HeyPCB Frosty
boards.summary: A snowman from every winter holiday film: two snowballs and a lot of rebuilding after the first one fell over.

boards.title: HeyPCB Fruit Bat
boards.role: Fruit Bat LED art, purple mask
boards.summary: A wide-winged bat leaving the cave at dusk.

boards.title: HeyPCB Big Heart
boards.role: Big Heart LED art, white mask
boards.summary: A big white heart, the one the tin man went looking for.

boards.title: HeyPCB Ice Gem
boards.role: Ice Gem LED art, blue mask
boards.summary: A blue gem from an ice palace in an animated fairy tale.

boards.title: HeyPCB Jack
boards.summary: A three-lobed pumpkin for a Halloween horror double bill. The first carving always goes wrong.

boards.title: HeyPCB Sky High
boards.role: Sky High LED art, blue mask
boards.summary: A big cloud for the film where an old man ties balloons to his house and flies away.

boards.title: HeyPCB Love Bug
boards.role: Love Bug LED art, red mask
boards.summary: A small red heart for the romantic comedy where the first date goes completely wrong.

boards.title: HeyPCB Mega Gear
boards.role: Mega Gear LED art, white mask
boards.summary: A twenty-tooth gear with a centre hole, from the clock tower in a chase scene.

boards.title: HeyPCB Moth
boards.summary: A white moth, drawn to the light, from a creature feature.

boards.title: HeyPCB Mothership
boards.summary: The biggest saucer in the set, hovering over the desert and playing five tones.

boards.title: HeyPCB Night Owl
boards.role: Night Owl LED art, purple mask
boards.summary: An owl with tufted ears, the kind that delivers letters in a wizarding film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Shuriken
boards.summary: A four-point throwing star from a martial-arts film, in black mask.

boards.title: HeyPCB Nine
boards.summary: A nine-sided tile from a puzzle-box film, where every wrong move teaches the next one.

boards.title: HeyPCB Paladin
boards.summary: A white knight's shield, dented in a hundred battles.

boards.title: HeyPCB Raider
boards.summary: A bigger, purple pixel alien. Game over is just the screen that asks whether you want to try again.

boards.title: HeyPCB Portal
boards.summary: A green portal ring. Step through, and the experiment either works or it doesn't.

boards.title: HeyPCB Turtle
boards.summary: A sea turtle riding the ocean current in an underwater animated film.

boards.title: HeyPCB Astronaut
boards.summary: An astronaut's helmet, for the mission that went wrong and still brought the crew home.

boards.title: HeyPCB Square One
boards.role: Square One LED art, blue mask
boards.summary: A plain square, for going back to square one. Most inventions start there more than once.

boards.title: HeyPCB Starburst
boards.summary: A ten-point starburst like the flash on an opening-night poster.

boards.title: HeyPCB Starfighter
boards.summary: A delta-wing starfighter from a space-opera hangar. Test pilots crash the prototypes so the final ship flies.

boards.title: HeyPCB Sunset
boards.summary: A twelve-ray sun in red, for the hero riding off into the sunset in the last shot.

boards.title: HeyPCB Luna
boards.summary: A small round moon, the smallest board in the set.

boards.title: HeyPCB Warp
boards.summary: A ring like the gate in a space-travel film, with light chasing round the rim.

boards.title: HeyPCB Submarine
boards.summary: A little yellow submarine from an animated music film, with a conning tower and a propeller.
